prompt.project_info: Create a full-body high-key studio portrait of one approved adult woman in a modern ethereal cupid-inspired fashion styling.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with messy ash-blonde updo, soft face-framing curls, natural luminous skin, pink blush, doll-like lashes, and a calm gentle expression. She wears a white satin mini slip dress with delicate scalloped lace trim, pale pink feathered wings, a textured gold glitter bow, white crew socks, and soft pink patent Mary Jane heels, holding a red heart-tipped arrow.
composition_elements: Centered vertical full-body crouched pose with head tilted and arrow held diagonally.
Seamless off-white/light-gray backdrop with clean negative space.
White, petal pink, cream, glittering gold, and soft red heart palette.
Keep satin, lace, feathers, glitter, arrow, socks, shoes, and natural skin texture clear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large diffused softbox with even high-key light, extremely soft shadows, gentle highlight bloom, and bright pastel romantic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 full-body portrait, 85mm lens at f/4, sharp face and costume detail, realistic satin, lace, feathers, glitter, and skin texture, subtle natural grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Modern ethereal cupid-inspired fashion portrait of one approved adult woman with a messy ash-blonde updo, soft face-framing curls, natural luminous skin, pink blush and doll-like lashes. She wears a white satin mini slip dress with delicate scalloped lace trim, pale pink feathered wings, a textured gold glitter bow, white crew socks and soft pink patent Mary Jane heels, holding a red heart-tipped arrow. Crouch in a centered three-quarter full-body pose with head tilted against a seamless off-white light-gray studio backdrop. Use diffused high-key even light, extremely soft shadows, gentle highlight bloom, white petal-pink cream gold and soft-red palette, 85mm lens, 4:5 framing, realistic textures, no text, no watermark.
